sloka: तदद्भुततरं श्रुत्वा देव्या वरमनुत्तमम् ।सम्प्रहृष्टमना भूत्वा राजा वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। ७.८७.२५ ॥
transliteration: tadadbhutataraṁ śrutvā devyā varamanuttamam ।samprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā rājā vākyamathābravīt ।। 7.87.25 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that most wonderful and unsurpassed boon from the goddess, the king became greatly delighted and then spoke.
